full_judgment: 16. Shahnewaz, Elahi Newaz, Muktara, Ameana, Khalilur and Mafizuddin are charge sheeted witnesses and also close relation of the appellant but none of them has been examined as witness and no reason has been assigned why the important witnesses have been withheld. Those witnesses being close relation of the appellant Lalu would have been in a position to testify about Lalu's state of mind prior or at the time of commission of the crime. Non-examination of competent witnesses has give rise to adverse presumption against prosecution.
